description: The batch release row finds the batch record review log

plan.attribute: QA release review signed before release
plan.procedure: Inspect executed batch records and the date of the QA release review.

row.risk: Batches released with incomplete or unreviewed records

row.objective: Every released batch has a complete executed batch record reviewed by QA first
testOfDesign: Confirm the control is defined and assigned
testOfEffectiveness: Inspect the sample for evidence the control operated
